description: A namespace that groups related classes, declared on the first line of a file and matched by the folder path.
The access level with no modifier, visible only to classes in the same package.
An access level visible to the same package and to subclasses in other packages.
The list of folders and jar files where the compiler and the JVM look for compiled classes.
A file that declares a named module, the packages it exports and the modules it requires.
A module-info directive that makes a package visible to other modules.
A class name with its package, such as com.example.library.app.Main, used to start a program or avoid a name clash.
